rationale:
Prior to this mock, your practice evidence demonstrated strong overall proficiency across diagnostic and adaptive sets (~92% overall accuracy), including 80% accuracy on Level 5 items.

In Reading & Writing (estimated ~690), you showed high mastery in text structure, boundaries, transitions, and comprehension, with minor misreads on fast-paced vocabulary items. In Math (estimated ~660), you executed flawlessly on linear algebra, systems, and functions, with slight vulnerabilities in statistical claims and volumetric scale factors.

The primary uncertainty is that your history lacks prior full-length mocks, so endurance over a full test form remains unverified.

The form you received is rated a 5 (very demanding). You routed to the higher adaptive module in both sections, and the form contained an intense hard tail, particularly in Reading & Writing where almost all questions were Level 5. Note that these estimates are benchmark counterfactuals and not official College Board scores.

Based on your extensive practice history prior to this attempt, including a prior 1500 full mock (770 RW / 730 Math) and high accuracy across adaptive practice sessions, your baseline expectation entering this form was 1490 (760 Reading & Writing, 730 Math). You demonstrate exceptional consistency in Reading & Writing, particularly with high-level structural analysis, central ideas, and rhetorical synthesis. Your primary source of score variance lies in Math, where solid conceptual mastery is occasionally offset by rushed execution (<35s per question) on Level 4/5 systems of equations, inequalities, and geometry. The main uncertainty in this baseline is whether improved paper setup and deliberate pacing on hard Math items will fully eliminate careless execution drops under timed test conditions.
